landing.ogDescription: A free app to catalogue the books you own, lend and borrow with friends, and track your reading.
landing.metaProfileDescription: {name}'s BookShelf — {count, plural, =0 {no books} one {# book} other {# books}} shared. Browse their library on BookShelf.
landing.aboutText: BookShelf is a book library app for people who own physical books. It lets you catalogue your home library, lend and borrow books with friends, buy and sell between friends, and track your reading. BookShelf is independently built, launched in 2025, hosted on Vercel, and available worldwide at bookshelf.name as a web app and an installable Progressive Web App for iOS and Android.
landing.faqWhatA: BookShelf is a free web app and Progressive Web App for cataloguing your personal book library and sharing books with friends. You can add the books you own, lend and borrow with friends, buy and sell, and track your reading.
landing.faqFreeA: Yes. BookShelf is free forever for up to 10 books. For an unlimited library it is $1/month or $10/year, with no ads and no data selling.
landing.faqLendQ: Can I lend books to friends?
landing.faqLendA: Yes. You can lend books to friends and track the whole lending workflow — request, approval, handoff, due dates, extensions, and return — all inside the app.
landing.faqMobileQ: Is there a mobile app for BookShelf?
landing.faqMobileA: BookShelf is a Progressive Web App you can install on iPhone and Android straight from your browser. It works like a native app, supports offline use, and needs no app store.
landing.faqLangA: BookShelf is available in English, Romanian, and Russian. It detects your language automatically and you can switch at any time.
landing.faqAddQ: How do I add books to my library?
landing.faqAddA: You can add books three ways: photograph the cover and let AI fill in the details, scan the ISBN, or type the title and author manually.
